option_relations.rationale: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a distinct disease entity and not directly related to Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis as a subtype, supertype, or direct cause/complication in this context.

Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease (KFD) complicated by hemophagocytosis and aseptic meningitis is a distinct disease entity and not directly related to Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis as a subtype, supertype, or direct cause/complication in this context.

Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV)-associated Hemophagocytic Syndrome is a distinct disease entity and not directly related to Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis as a subtype, supertype, or direct cause/complication in this context.

Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a distinct autoimmune disease and not directly related to Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis as a subtype, supertype, or direct cause/complication in this context.
